comments.body: Taking "looks good" as approval of the design and types. Building now: slice 1 (shapes and contract) first, then the hub, web and server slices in parallel. **Slice 2** (moving zoned instants into dayspan, a dayspan release, switching Oryoli) is postponed until you say so, because it edits your other repos and publishes; the schedule system carries the helper itself meanwhile.
